name: TOB Blessing Automation Settings
description: Control panel for the daily blessing post automation. The posting worker runs on the separate outreach VPS (tob-social, systemd timer every 15 minutes) and reads these settings plus the approved TOB Blessing Verse list through social/blessing_automation.py on every run; it writes each preview/post/failure to TOB Automation Log. Turning 'Automatic posting' off takes effect on the worker's next run. The Slack bot token is stored here (encrypted); the Meta token lives in TOB Meta Connection. The worker's .env holds only its own Frappe login.

fields.label: Automatic posting ON
fields.description: Master switch. When off, the worker posts nothing and sends no previews.

fields.label: Post Time (India time)
fields.description: The worker checks every 15 minutes, so the post goes out within 15 minutes after this time.

fields.label: Time Zone
fields.description: IANA time zone for every post time, e.g. Asia/Kolkata.

fields.label: Instagram
fields.description: Instagram reuses the image Facebook hosts, so it only posts when Facebook is also on.

fields.label: Send Previews To
fields.description: Where the worker sends the image + caption before posting, and each post's result.

fields.label: Slack Channel ID
fields.description: Channel ID (starts with C), e.g. #project-truthofbible = C0BRUBKRLE5. Invite the bot to the channel first: /invite @qtt

fields.label: Slack Bot Token
fields.description: The only copy of the Slack bot token (xoxb-…), stored encrypted. The outreach VPS worker receives it with its settings; it keeps no copy.

fields.label: Preview Minutes Before Posting
fields.description: Gives time to switch posting off or un-approve the verse if something looks wrong.

fields.label: Scheduled Content Posts
fields.description: Extra posts on chosen weekdays, one row per content type (App Feature, Salvation Prayer, ...). Only TOB Social Content ticked 'Checked & approved' is used; the least recently posted goes next. 'Automatic posting ON' above is the master switch for these too.

fields.label: Worker Last Checked In
fields.description: Updated on every worker run. If this is more than ~30 minutes old, the worker or its server is down.
